dx_raw:
DIAGNOPS: Opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome, paraneoplastic or post-infectious/autoimmune etiology

Alternative diagnoses:
1. Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration with opsoclonus (underlying malignancy not yet detected)
2. Post-infectious cerebellitis
3. Idiopathic opsoclonus-myoclonus syndrome

Given these findings, I would urgently order paraneoplastic antibody panel (anti-Hu, anti-Yo, anti-Ri, anti-CV2/CRMP5, anti-amphiphysin), whole-body CT or PET-CT to screen for occult malignancy (particularly breast, lung, gynecological in adults; neuroblastoma in children), and lumbar puncture for CSF analysis including cytology and oligoclonal bands.
